svg.title: Hairdresser — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as hairdresser, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Open hair-cutting scissors have two clear finger loops beside a separate four-tooth comb. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face.
